Alex: Quick sync — finalizing run-of-show + speaker contingency matrix for Wed 9am PT. Draft below, need quick sign-off.
Priya: copying notes from speaker ops — we have one potential APAC conflict (Sato) who may need a 2nd slot or pre-recorded segment. @Alex can you confirm priority? :eyes:
Mateo: Demo team can pre-record the heavy-load demo as a 2:00 clip and keep a short live fallback (30s). That reduces setup risk.
Jamie: Sounds good. If we move the customer case ahead of the deep demo it helps story arc. Proposal: customer -> tech deep dive -> live Qs.
Alex: ok let's try that reorder. Can someone paste an updated run-of-show?
Priya: pasted — small matrix (live vs pre-record) and who owns fallback.
Priya: ```
09:00 PT - Welcome + agenda (Alex) 3m
09:03 PT - Customer case (Jamie + Customer rep) 12m (live)
09:15 PT - Tech deep dive (Mateo) 12m (recorded heavy demo fallback -> live 2min summary)
09:27 PT - Product highlights + roadmap (Alex) 6m
09:33 PT - Live Q&A (All) 12m
09:45 PT - Close & next steps 3m
```
Mateo: For the demo fallback: we keep a short `live_summary.md` script for the 2min live clip. If infra flops we swap to the 2:00 recorded clip and annotate in OBS.
Alex: who will watch the stream health and flip? @Mateo or @Priya?
Mateo: I'll own the flip. Mateo: will be in greenroom with remote OBS control.
Priya: I'll own speaker hotswap — messaging and cueing. I'll add a Slack DM playbook for each speaker.
Jamie: We should also prepare a 1-slide summary of the benchmark narrative to surface during the tech deep dive. Short bullets + one graph. I'll draft and share by EOD. :thumbsup:
Alex: rehearsal schedule: dry run + tech check Tues 10am PT, full run Wed 8:15am PT (45m). ops-bot will post invites.
ops-bot: Reminder created — Rehearsal Tue 10:00 PT (link: https://meet.example/rehearsal) and Full run Wed 8:15 PT (link: https://meet.example/fullrun).
Priya: action items: (1) Jamie drafts benchmark slide (EOD), (2) Mateo pre-record demo + `live_summary.md` (EOD), (3) Alex updates run-of-show doc and pins in channel (EOD), (4) Priya writes speaker DM playbook (tomorrow morning).
Alex: thanks — if no objections i'll lock the run-of-show by EOD. :v:
Mateo: No objections from demo.
Jamie: Good to go from content side.
Priya: All set from ops.
Alex: locked. I'll pin final doc and send calendar invites with greenroom details.
